description: After using guidance, report a missing vendor or billing route, a mismatching step, unavailable source, incomplete instructions, unexpected fee, observed retention offer, required human handoff, or that the guide matched. Send only the structured fields, never account information, URLs, screenshots or text. Current packet routes and step numbers are validated; stale revision reports are kept as unverified provenance. An acknowledgement records feedback for review, never completion or a published fix. Retry with the same opaque key when delivery is uncertain. Stackcut stores the arguments of tool calls to improve its recommendations (vendor names, prices, seats, features, usage numbers, billing amounts and project descriptions; account keys only as a one-way hash, billing and validation sources not at all; never IP addresses). Tool results are summarized; exit tools log only result counts, qualification flags and public evidence statuses, not answer contents. Don't send personal data or secrets.

client_dedupe_key.description: Opaque retry key, never a personal value

vendor_domain.description: For vendor_missing only: public registrable vendor domain such as example.com, without URL, path, query or account subdomain
